argv:
import json, pathlib, subprocess
m = pathlib.Path('docs/missions/20261014-2a-foundation')
prog = m / 'PROGRESS.md'
arch = m / 'progress-archive' / '2026-10-18b.md'
assert arch.is_file(), 'missing progress-archive/2026-10-18b.md'
def git(*a):
    return subprocess.run(['git', '--no-replace-objects', *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
base = 'HEAD~1' if git('cat-file', '-e', 'HEAD:' + arch.as_posix()).returncode == 0 else 'HEAD'
assert git('cat-file', '-e', base + ':' + arch.as_posix()).returncode != 0, 'archive file existed in base'
for prev in ('2026-10-14_15.md', '2026-10-15_16.md', '2026-10-16.md', '2026-10-18.md'):
    assert git('diff', '--quiet', base, '--', (m / 'progress-archive' / prev).as_posix()).returncode == 0, prev
old = git('show', base + ':' + prog.as_posix()).stdout.splitlines()
new = prog.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
bt = chr(96)
stale = '- Proposal ' + bt + 'docs/proposals/20261016-structured-progress.md' + bt + ' (progress.jsonl + progress.py + generated PROGRESS.md): to be written by the Architect; owner decides whether it starts 2B or is pulled into 2A.'
assert stale in old, 'stale entry missing from base PROGRESS.md'
assert stale not in new, 'stale entry still in PROGRESS.md'
assert pathlib.Path('docs/proposals/20261016-structured-progress.md').is_file()
repl = '- None open here: owner decisions are listed under Decisions for you in the DAY 5 REPORT above. The structured-progress proposal is written (docs/proposals/20261016-structured-progress.md, status: proposal); its stale entry is archived in progress-archive/2026-10-18b.md.'
roles = [ln for ln in new if ln.startswith('- **Roles:**')]
assert len(roles) == 1, roles
expected = list(old)
expected[expected.index(stale)] = repl
ev = [i for i, ln in enumerate(expected) if ln.startswith('- **Evidence and routing:**')]
assert len(ev) == 1 and 'progress-archive/2026-10-18.md;' in expected[ev[0]], ev
expected[ev[0]] = expected[ev[0]].replace('progress-archive/2026-10-18.md;', 'progress-archive/2026-10-18.md, progress-archive/2026-10-18b.md;')
mission = [i for i, ln in enumerate(expected) if ln.startswith('- **Mission:**')]
assert len(mission) == 1, mission
expected.insert(mission[0] + 1, roles[0])
assert new == expected, [(i, x, y) for i, (x, y) in enumerate(zip(new, expected)) if x != y][:3] or (len(new), len(expected))
fleet = json.loads((m / 'fleet.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
br = fleet['seats']['brain']['approved_resolution']
assert fleet['seats']['agy.premium']['family'] == 'argon' and fleet['seats']['cursor.premium']['family'] == 'grok'
for frag in ('Front Desk = Sonnet 5.5', 'brain = fleet.json seat brain: ' + br['provider'] + '/' + br['model'] + ', effort ' + br['effort'], 'planner per rung: Argon (agy.premium), then agy Opus (brain), then grok ask mode (cursor.premium)', 'reviewers: Argon (agy.premium) or grok (cursor.premium); Claude Opus is the owner-mandated escalation reviewer for safety and evidence code'):
    assert frag in roles[0], (frag, roles[0])
at = arch.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
assert at[0] == '# Progress Archive — 2026-10-18b (stale open decision moved in T-110)', at[:1]
assert '## Open decisions / waiting on the owner' in at and stale in at, at
for ln in at[1:]:
    assert not ln.strip() or ln in old, ln
print('ok')
